Game Overview

At its heart, Crumpled Pictures is a puzzle game about unravel crumpled pictures to reveal their hidden beauty. Straighten, collect, and sort images into your personal album while earning coins. Challenge yourself for higher rewards, unlock achievements, and compete with others. Expand your album or discard less-loved photos as you aim for picture-perfect glory!

How to Play

Getting started in Crumpled Pictures doesn't take long to learn. Unravel crumpled pictures to reveal their hidden beauty! Straighten, collect, and sort images into your personal album while earning coins. Challenge yourself for higher rewards, unlock achievements, and compete with others. Expand your album or discard less-loved photos as you aim for picture-perfect glory!
